title: IntraFuzz: Coverage-Guided Intra-Enclave Fuzzing for Intel SGX Applications
problem: Intel SGX applications are vulnerable to intra-enclave software vulnerabilities; existing automated bug-finding methods focus on fuzzing enclave boundaries in simulated environments, missing vulnerabilities in actual hardware-protected enclaves.
motivation: SGX provides hardware-enforced isolation, but application-level bugs within enclaves are difficult to detect; hardware-based fuzzing in actual enclaves is needed for comprehensive security validation.
method: IntraFuzz is the first system enabling efficient coverage-guided fuzzing of SGX applications inside actual hardware-protected Intel SGX enclaves. The system integrates with SGX runtime to instrument enclave code and collect coverage feedback during fuzzing, enabling hardware-based vulnerability detection on real SGX platforms.
key_novelty: First coverage-guided fuzzing system for SGX applications running in actual hardware enclaves rather than simulation.
contributions: First intra-enclave fuzzing system on actual SGX hardware (Intel Xeon with up to 256GB EPC)
Detected all vulnerabilities from prior work (EnclaveFuzz) plus 6 previously undiscovered vulnerabilities

metrics.security: all known vulnerabilities + 6 new vulnerabilities detected

primary_theme: Hardware-based fuzzing for SGX enclave security
